h7.claim: An insider cannot link CPPR's pooled verdicts (criterion G3)
h7.rule: upper bound of the corrected-t 95% interval of the per-seed max-over-attackers G3 AUC < 0.60, on each network
h7.status_before_holm: interval rule not met: the paper states that criterion G3 is unmet

method.g3: Per seed and attacker, the mean over (pooled verdict, true rater) items of the within-pool AUC of the true rater against the other pool members (ties 1/2), on the direct arm's verdicts. An item is a distinct true rater of a verdict (a dump row with label 1). Single-member pools are excluded and counted; the sensitivity scores each of their items as AUC 1.
method.attackers: handcrafted: keeper.cppr.linkage.linkage_attack's combined score, recomputed from the dump's structure, timing and model_prob with its within-run half orientation (verdict index parity). Single signals: structure, timing, model_prob, degree, activity, activity_window, each oriented by the sign of its mean item AUC on the other seeds. learned: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=0, early_stopping=False) on structure, timing, model_prob, degree, activity, activity_window, candidate_tier, pool_size, pool_tier, fitted on the other seeds' candidate rows of the same family (label = true rater), scoring the held-out seed.
method.h7: Per seed, the maximum over the attackers of G3 on the capped-BTP E3 runs (cppr_btp); defined when every attacker is. Test: one-sided corrected t of mean < 0.60, variance factor 1 + J n_test / n_train with n_test / n_train = 1 / (J - 1) (leave one seed out; J = seeds); headline interval: the two-sided 95% corrected-t interval, clipped to [0, 1]. Supported on a network when its upper bound is < 0.60; contradicted when its lower bound is > 0.60; fewer than 80% of the seeds: not evaluable.
method.secondary: Top-1: per item 1/k when the true rater ties k members at the pool's maximum score, else 0 (the driver's block counts any tie at the maximum as a hit); chance: the mean of 1 / pool size over items. Learned attacker: permutation importance = drop of the held-out seed's G3 when one feature is permuted over its rows (one permutation, seeded); timing partial dependence at the 10/50/90% quantiles of the training rows' timing. Bootstrap sensitivity: nested, seeds then pooled verdicts within seed, the attackers' scores fixed.
